rolePolicy.appOwner: full journal; review,clear/delete; exact owner alert destination
rolePolicy.appAdmin: flag-scoped non-security journal; review; no clear/delete; no owner-alert route
rolePolicy.organizationOwnerAdminEditor: No independent system-journal entitlement; only app-global role can grant it
rolePolicy.ordinaryRestrictedGuest: No journal browsing or review; direct server access denied by active-user/role/MFA/rules checks. Full UI variant acceptance remains open.
